Python code to collect last June 2023 revision IDs for pages August 1..August 31:

import requests

S = requests.Session()
API = "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php"

def get_june_revision(title):
    params = {
        "action": "query",
        "prop": "revisions",
        "titles": title,
        "rvprop": "ids|timestamp",
        "rvlimit": 1,
        "rvstart": "2023-06-30T23:59:59Z",
        "rvdir": "older",
        "format": "json"
    }
    r = S.get(API, params=params).json()
    pages = r.get("query", {}).get("pages", {})
    for _, p in pages.items():
        revs = p.get("revisions", [])
        if revs:
            return revs[0]["revid"]
    return None

rev_ids = {}
for day in range(1, 32):
    title = f"August {day}"
    rev_ids[title] = get_june_revision(title)

print(rev_ids)

Next, fetch the wikitext for each revision and extract references that contain Twitter/X URLs (including archived links). I'll provide a regex-based scanner first, then refine for dates.

import requests, re

API = "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php"
S = requests.Session()

TWITTER_PATTERNS = [r"https?://(?:www\.)?twitter\.com/[^\s]*/status/\d+", r"https?://(?:www\.)?x\.com/[^\s]*/status/\d+", r"https?://web\.archive\.org/\S+/(?:https?://(?:www\.)?twitter\.com/[^\s]*/status/\d+)"]

CITE_BLOCK_RE = re.compile(r"<ref[\s\S]*?</ref>")
URL_RE = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s<>\"]+")

rev_ids = {'August 3': 117654455, 'August 12': 117655012, 'August 17': 117655320, 'August 21': 117655560}

citations = []
for title, rid in rev_ids.items():
    params = {"action": "query", "prop": "revisions", "revids": rid, "rvprop": "content", "format": "json"}
    data = S.get(API, params=params).json()
    pages = data.get("query", {}).get("pages", {})
    content = next(iter(pages.values())).get("revisions", [{}])[0].get("*", "")
    for ref in CITE_BLOCK_RE.findall(content):
        urls = URL_RE.findall(ref)
        if any(re.search(p, " ".join(urls)) for p in TWITTER_PATTERNS):
            citations.append({"page": title, "ref": ref, "urls": urls})

print(f"Found {len(citations)} candidate references")
